event.name: Pitch Competition
event.description:
An opportunity for founders to pitch their startups directly in front of investors, mentors, and the startup community. Participants will present their ideas, business models, and vision while receiving valuable feedback from experienced investors and industry leaders.

During the competition, founders will have the chance to showcase their company, explain the problem they are solving, highlight their growth potential, and share why their startup is worth investing in.

Whether you are raising your first round or looking to refine your pitch, this event provides a platform to practice presenting your vision, connect with investors, and gain insights to help take your startup forward.

Come pitch your startup, get feedback, and connect with people who can help you grow.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

partners.companyDescription: Homebrew Club is a modern co-working space designed for founders, creators, freelancers, and professionals looking for a productive environment to work, collaborate, and build. It provides flexible workspaces, a vibrant community, and resources that help individuals and teams grow their ideas into successful ventures.
